new_today.title: A graph-attentive GAN for rare-cell-aware single-cell RNA-seq data generation
new_today.title_zh: 一种用于稀有细胞感知单细胞RNA-seq数据生成的图注意力GAN
new_today.summary_zh: 单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）下游分析的一个核心挑战是高维小样本（HDSS）情形，且常因稀有细胞类型而加剧类别不平衡。这些因素阻碍了稳健的特征（基因）选择和细胞聚类，并限制了现有模拟器生成样本的真实性。我们提出GARAGE，一种图注意力稀有细胞感知单细胞数据生成方法，在先验噪声之外，用少量、注意力加权的真实细胞“泄漏”来增强生成器输入。具体来说，我们构建k近邻细胞图，并使用图注意力网络（GAT）优先选择可能代表欠采样（稀有）亚群的节点；这些高注意力细胞嵌入被注入生成器输入，以引导合成朝向数据流形中生物学上合理的区域，同时尊重细胞类型比例。这种注意力引导泄漏加速训练，减少模式丢失，并生成保留稀有细胞结构的真实合成细胞。在真实scRNA-seq基准上，GARAGE相比最先进基线改善了下游特征选择和聚类。总之，GARAGE通过将图注意力与对抗生成结合，直接应对scRNA-seq中的HDS

extra.description: A central challenge in downstream single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) analysis is the high-dimensional, small-sample (HDSS) regime, often compounded by class imbalance from rare cell types. These factors hinder robust feature (gene) selection and cell clustering and limit the realism of samples generated by existing simulators. We introduce GARAGE , a G raph- A ttentive RA re-cell aware single-cell data GE neration that augments the generator’s input with a small, attention-weighted ‘leakage’ of real cells in addition to prior noise. Specifically, we build a k -nearest-neighbour cell graph and use a graph attention network (GAT) to prioritize nodes that likely represent under-sampled (rare) subpopulations; these high-attention cell embeddings are injected into the generator input to steer synthesis toward biologically plausible regions of the data manifold while respecting cell-type proportions. This attention-guided leakage accelerates training, reduces mode dropping, and yields realistic synthetic cells that preserve rare-cell structure. Across real scRNA-seq benchmarks, GARAGE improves downstream feature selection and clustering compared with state-of-the-art baselines. In summary, GARAGE directly addresses HDSS and rarity in scRNA-seq by coupling graph attention with adversarial generation to produce high-fidelity synthetic cells that enhance downstream analyses. The corresponding software is available at: https://github.com/RitwikGanguly/GARAGE .

new_today.summary_zh: 肿瘤是克隆亚群细胞在时间和空间中共同进化的异质混合物。除遗传差异外，癌症克隆可能位于肿瘤组织不同位置，并表现出多种转录表型，具有特定基因表达谱和标记基因。目前缺乏同时推断肿瘤组织中克隆基因型和转录表型的计算工具。我们提出CLONALGE，一种概率图模型，用于识别癌症克隆基因型、其基因表达谱及在肿瘤组织中的空间映射。该模型通过将空间转录组学中的单核苷酸变异位点与DNA测序数据推断的克隆特异性变异进行概率匹配，并将空间转录组学斑点中的基因表达解卷积为各个克隆的贡献。我们提出一种程序，利用蒙特卡洛后验样本识别克隆间差异表达基因，使用最高密度区间加实际等效区域（HDI+ROPE）标准，同时要求可信且实际有意义的效应量。CLONALGE在模拟数据上表现出优越性能。应用于前列腺癌样本时，它揭示了克隆特异性表达模式，并在准确推断基因表达谱和解释空间转录组信号方面优于其前身模型。我们的方法推进了肿瘤中克隆

extra.description: Tumors are heterogeneous mixtures of clonal subpopulations of cells that co-evolve in time and space. Apart from genetic differences, cancer clones may reside in different locations in the tumor tissue and show various transcriptional phenotypes, with specific gene expression profiles and marker genes. Computational tools that simultaneously infer genotypes and transcriptional phenotypes of clones in tumor tissues are lacking. We introduce CLONALGE, a probabilistic graphical model identifying cancer clone genotypes, their gene expression profiles, and spatial mapping within tumor tissue. The model proceeds by probabilistic matching of single nucleotide variant sites in spatial transcriptomics to clone-specific variants inferred from DNA sequencing data, and by deconvoluting gene expression in spatial transcriptomics spots into contributions from individual clones. We propose a procedure that utilizes the Monte Carlo posterior samples for identification of differentially expressed genes between clones, using a Highest Density Interval plus Region of Practical Equivalence (HDI+ROPE) criterion that jointly requires credible and practically meaningful effect sizes. CLONALGE demonstrates superior performance on simulated data. Applied to a prostate cancer sample, it reveals clone-specific expression patterns and outperforms its predecessor model in accurately inferring gene expression profiles and explaining spatial transcriptomics signals. Our approach advances the functional and phenotypic characterization of clonal cell subpopulations in tumors. The implementation of CLONALGE and the data used in this study can be accessed in the following GitHub repository https://github.com/szczurek-lab/ClonalGE/. The benchmarking data alongside the intermediate results are available on Zenodo at DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.20446991.

longest_on_board.title: A graph-attentive GAN for rare-cell-aware single-cell RNA-seq data generation
longest_on_board.title_zh: 一种用于稀有细胞感知单细胞RNA-seq数据生成的图注意力GAN
longest_on_board.summary_zh: 单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）下游分析的一个核心挑战是高维小样本（HDSS）情形，且常因稀有细胞类型而加剧类别不平衡。这些因素阻碍了稳健的特征（基因）选择和细胞聚类，并限制了现有模拟器生成样本的真实性。我们提出GARAGE，一种图注意力稀有细胞感知单细胞数据生成方法，在先验噪声之外，用少量、注意力加权的真实细胞“泄漏”来增强生成器输入。具体来说，我们构建k近邻细胞图，并使用图注意力网络（GAT）优先选择可能代表欠采样（稀有）亚群的节点；这些高注意力细胞嵌入被注入生成器输入，以引导合成朝向数据流形中生物学上合理的区域，同时尊重细胞类型比例。这种注意力引导泄漏加速训练，减少模式丢失，并生成保留稀有细胞结构的真实合成细胞。在真实scRNA-seq基准上，GARAGE相比最先进基线改善了下游特征选择和聚类。总之，GARAGE通过将图注意力与对抗生成结合，直接应对scRNA-seq中的HDS

extra.description: A central challenge in downstream single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) analysis is the high-dimensional, small-sample (HDSS) regime, often compounded by class imbalance from rare cell types. These factors hinder robust feature (gene) selection and cell clustering and limit the realism of samples generated by existing simulators. We introduce GARAGE , a G raph- A ttentive RA re-cell aware single-cell data GE neration that augments the generator’s input with a small, attention-weighted ‘leakage’ of real cells in addition to prior noise. Specifically, we build a k -nearest-neighbour cell graph and use a graph attention network (GAT) to prioritize nodes that likely represent under-sampled (rare) subpopulations; these high-attention cell embeddings are injected into the generator input to steer synthesis toward biologically plausible regions of the data manifold while respecting cell-type proportions. This attention-guided leakage accelerates training, reduces mode dropping, and yields realistic synthetic cells that preserve rare-cell structure. Across real scRNA-seq benchmarks, GARAGE improves downstream feature selection and clustering compared with state-of-the-art baselines. In summary, GARAGE directly addresses HDSS and rarity in scRNA-seq by coupling graph attention with adversarial generation to produce high-fidelity synthetic cells that enhance downstream analyses. The corresponding software is available at: https://github.com/RitwikGanguly/GARAGE .
